text:
sam: Heads-up — running the private installer behind a multi-hop egress proxy (corp proxy -> NAT GW) and seeing mTLS failures to KMS. Root error: "tls: handshake failure" and "x509: certificate signed by unknown authority". Logs below.

sam: ```
2026-03-20T14:02:11Z installer: dialing kms.internal:443
2026-03-20T14:02:11Z installer: tls: handshake failure
2026-03-20T14:02:11Z installer: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority
```

maya: Can you paste the systemd drop-in / env config for the installer service? We've run into proxies stripping SNI on chain hops before.

sam: systemd drop-in I'm using:```
[Service]
Environment=HTTP_PROXY=http://proxy.corp:8080 
Environment=HTTPS_PROXY=http://proxy.corp:8080 
Environment=NO_PROXY=127.0.0.1,10.0.0.0/8,kms.internal 
Environment=REDWOOD_INSTALL_TLS_MODE=auto 
Environment=REDWOOD_MTLS_CA_PATH=/etc/redwood/ca.pem
```

liam: If the corporate proxy is TLS-terminating for outbound, you need either: 1) passthrough mode so installer preserves TLS to KMS, or 2) ensure the proxy presents the internal cert chain (rare). Quick debug curl that helped me reproduce earlier: `curl --resolve kms.internal:443:10.0.0.5 --cacert /etc/redwood/ca.pem https://kms.internal/health` — if that fails with x509, the CA isn't trusted by the node/proxy.

maya: I opened a docs PR that adds a dedicated section for multi-hop proxies + recommended systemd drop-in + troubleshooting steps: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842. It also fixes the broken link in the installer networking section. Can reviewers take a look? @kevin @liam

docs-bot: PR #842 created by maya — CI queued, reviewers requested: kevin, liam. (automated note)

kevin: I can review. Two items: 1) add a short migration note for on-prem customers using HSM/PKCS#11 — they often need PKCS11_MODULE_PATH in the installer env so the service can load the token library; 2) recommend adding the corporate CA to system trust (`/etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/` + `update-ca-trust`) for RHEL distros. I'll push a small follow-up commit to the PR.

sam: Quick verification from my air-gapped lab: adding the corp CA to /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors and setting NO_PROXY for internal nets fixed the x509 error. HSM still failed until I set `PKCS11_MODULE_PATH=/opt/hsm/lib/libpkcs11.so` in the installer env.

liam: SDK snippet for dev/local tests (node):
```js
const fs = require('fs');
const https = require('https');
const agent = new https.Agent({ ca: fs.readFileSync('/etc/redwood/ca.pem') });
fetch('https://kms.internal/health', { agent })
  .then(r => r.text())
  .then(console.log)
  .catch(e => console.error(e));
```

maya: Also fixed a stale marketplace link under the Private/VPC networking appendix (was pointing to old AMI doc). Included the corrected URL in the PR body.

sam: :thumbsup: I'll run a full e2e with HSM attached tomorrow and post results here. If anyone else has a production repro, please drop logs here (especially proxy logs if possible).

kevin: Leaving a small note in the PR to call out that customers behind transparent TLS-inspecting proxies should use `REDWOOD_INSTALL_TLS_MODE=passthrough` and test with the curl resolve trick before rolling to prod.

liam: Acked. After PR merges we should cut a short doc snippet into the onboarding quickstart so users see this earlier.

maya: Thanks all — assigning to kevin for review + merging once CI is green.
